biotools.summary: Pydidas is a Python-based toolset for automated X-ray diffraction data analysis, designed to be accessible to users with varying levels of expertise and scalable across different computing environments. It provides a graphical user interface and modular processing pipeline for data browsing, calibration, workflow setup, processing, and visualization.
